response:
Thank you for sharing this — reaching out takes real courage, and wanting to recover as you start this new chapter shows incredible strength. Bulimia is treatable, and you don't have to face it alone.

I'd encourage you to start by connecting with professionals who specialize in eating disorders. A good first step is contacting your school's student health or counseling center — they can often provide support or referrals. You can also reach out to the **National Eating Disorders Association (NEDA)** Helpline at 1-800-931-2237 or visit their website at nationaleatingdisorders.org for guidance and resources. A therapist who specializes in eating disorders, along with a registered dietitian and possibly a medical provider, can help you build a recovery team.

Recovery is a process, and setbacks don't mean failure. Please consider telling a trusted person in your life so you have support along the way. You deserve care and healing.
